Per the project's recorded release convention (an EngramDB memory):

1. Push a git tag named `vYYYY.MM.N`. `N` is the release number within that month. For example, `v2026.09.2` was the second release in September 2026. Today is 2026-10-01, so the first release this month would be `v2026.10.1`, if no `v2026.10.*` tag exists yet.
2. CI builds and publishes from that tag. Never publish by hand.

Here is what that looks like as commands:

```
git tag v2026.10.1
git push origin v2026.10.1
```

Before you pick `N`, run `git tag -l 'v2026.10.*'` to see which numbers are taken.
